embarkation.recommended_arrival_window: 30 minutes prior to assigned check-in slot on Cruise Ticket
embarkation.terminal_baggage_drop: Porcelain luggage tags must be stapled before terminal porter hand-off
embarkation.stateroom_readiness_hour: 14:00 (Staterooms accessible via Cruise Card in door slot)
embarkation.mandatory_safety_drill: Watch safety video in cabin TV -> Dial 881 on cabin phone -> Walk to assigned Muster Station for card scan

gangway_operations.all_aboard_strict_buffer: All guests must be scanned on board 30 minutes before published departure time.

onboard_connectivity.msc_for_me_app: Operates free of charge over ship Wi-Fi intranet without purchasing internet package
